# ProtoPeek

ProtoPeek is a performance-first gRPC workbench and independent open source project by Shreyam Adhikari.

Primary site: https://shreyam1008.github.io/ProtoPeek/
Author: https://shreyam1008.com.np/
Repository: https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek

Summary:
- Launch ProtoPeek with no target and define one or more saved gRPC endpoints from the UI.
- Explore proto files, services, messages, enums, dependencies, and export raw `.proto` text.
- Generate starter JSON payloads from reflected schemas.
- Inspect metadata, trailers, status, latency, and run lightweight simulation checks.

Preferred docs:
- https://shreyam1008.github.io/ProtoPeek/
- https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek
- https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek/blob/main/README.md
- https://github.com/shreyam1008/ProtoPeek/blob/main/guides/feature-roadmap.md

Upstream note:
- ProtoPeek started from grpcui and now continues as its own project with a small thanks to the original upstream.
